It is found throughout Europe and North Africa, east across Siberia to the Russian Far East, and south to Pakistan, India, China and Japan. It is a mold feeder often found in: stored products such as grains and dry fruit, houses, feed mills, grain elevators, manure heaps and plant detritus. Euxestidae contain around 70 extant species in 11 genera, distributed primarily in the tropical and subtropical regions of Afro-Eurasia.

161452.l: Alexiidae is a family of beetles. They are fungivores, having been observed feeding on mushrooms, and have also been found in leaf litter and on decaying bark.
